column1: # LLVM builds of kernels for AMD cards, compiled outside the Metal shader compiler.
# How the rows are used: nothing reads this table yet. No lane with an LLVM source is wired (lanes.tsv has no row with
# source llvm-archive or llvm-native). It records the toolchain a first LLVM lane would be built with.
# To add a row: one per card, with the build that was tried in source.
#   pci: the card as 0xVVVV:0xDDDD (PCI vendor and device id, lower-case hex). A card with no row has no LLVM build recorded.
#   llvm: the LLVM version the build was made with.
#   mcpu: the -mcpu value for the card's chip.
#   source: what was done with this toolchain for the card (built, compiled only, run or not). Free text, no tab.
